plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Plan, execute and review as one pipeline: ship conducts super-plan (wave-native planning with a shipped plan linter) into supervised multi-model waves on a feature branch and a reviewed PR — isolated executors judged against machine-checkable contracts; the merge stays with the user. Every link also runs standalone. Adapts to whichever model orchestrates.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Critical code review of uncommitted changes or a GitHub PR, plus a post-review fix phase that answers and resolves the PR threads its findings came from. Adapts to whichever model reviews.
